assessment: All 26 selected Source/Evidence records were reviewed, with focused independent checking of the nine new Source revision bindings and their Notion Evidence Notes EV-000336 through EV-000344. The prior method-coverage F001 is addressed by Wiener recursive filtering, particle prognostics, physics-informed and physics-guided RUL, and self-supervised domain adaptation evidence. The prior evaluation-coverage F002 is addressed by industrial interval-censoring, prognostic-horizon and alpha-lambda metrics, time-dependent survival risk/Brier/IPCW, and observed industrial future-alarm window studies. Original publication abstracts and accessible primary sources support these bounded descriptions. Synthetic benchmark and real-fleet transfer, actual failure and future alarm, interval and informative censoring, and methodological review versus empirical calibration are correctly distinguished. No material new source-fidelity or selection omission was identified.
